title: 一般外科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋急性腹症（闌尾炎、膽囊炎、腸阻塞、穿孔）、腹腔鏡膽囊切除與膽管損傷預防、疝氣修補、大腸直腸癌切除與造口照護、乳房與甲狀腺手術、創傷剖腹與損傷控制、胰臟炎、肛門直腸疾病、減重手術、傷口與手術部位感染、ERAS 與吻合口滲漏的早期辨識。
introEn: This library covers the acute abdomen (appendicitis, cholecystitis, bowel obstruction, perforation), laparoscopic cholecystectomy and bile-duct injury prevention, hernia repair, colorectal cancer resection and stoma care, breast and thyroid surgery, trauma laparotomy and damage control, pancreatitis, anorectal disease, bariatric surgery, wounds and surgical-site infection, ERAS and early recognition of anastomotic leak.

procedures.title: 急性闌尾炎診斷路徑（Alvarado／AIR 評分與影像）
procedures.titleEn: Acute appendicitis diagnostic pathway (Alvarado/AIR scores and imaging)
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：23 歲女性，右下腹痛 18 小時，由肚臍周圍移行而來，噁心、食慾不振。急診主治、住院醫師與超音波技術員共同評估。本單元教評分、影像選擇與決策，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 23-year-old woman with 18 hours of right lower quadrant pain that migrated from the periumbilical region, nausea and anorexia. The ED attending, resident and sonographer assess her together. Teaches scoring, imaging choice and decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 病史的關鍵
stages.evidence: 肚臍周圍痛移行至右下腹，噁心、不想吃；住院醫師想直接排手術。
stages.evidenceEn: Periumbilical pain migrating to the right lower quadrant, nausea, anorexia; the resident wants to book theatre now.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 症狀典型，直接排腹腔鏡闌尾切除術
choices.en: Typical story: book laparoscopic appendicectomy now

choices.zh: 補問移行痛、月經性行為史與泌尿症狀
choices.en: Ask about migration, menstrual/sexual history and urinary symptoms

choices.zh: 先排腹部 CT，待影像結果再補問病史
choices.en: Order abdominal CT first; take the history afterwards

stages.reason: 移行痛是最有鑑別力的症狀；育齡女性的婦科與妊娠鑑別不可省略。
stages.reasonEn: Migration is the most discriminating symptom; gynaecological and pregnancy differentials cannot be skipped in women of childbearing age.
stages.pitfall: 若省略婦科史：子宮外孕或卵巢扭轉被當成闌尾炎送進手術室。
stages.pitfallEn: Skipping the gynaecological history sends an ectopic pregnancy or ovarian torsion to theatre as appendicitis.

stages.title: 理學檢查
stages.evidence: McBurney 點壓痛、反彈痛、Rovsing 徵象陽性；體溫 37.9°C。
stages.evidenceEn: McBurney's point tenderness, rebound, positive Rovsing's sign; temperature 37.9°C.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 腹膜受刺激，支持急性闌尾炎
choices.en: Peritoneal irritation supporting acute appendicitis

choices.zh: Rovsing 陽性指向左側病灶
choices.en: A positive Rovsing's sign points to a left-sided lesion

choices.zh: 仍須直腸指檢確認才能下診斷
choices.en: A rectal exam is still needed to confirm it

stages.reason: 反彈痛與 Rovsing 徵象反映壁層腹膜受刺激；直腸指檢的附加價值很低。
stages.reasonEn: Rebound and Rovsing's sign reflect parietal peritoneal irritation; rectal examination adds little.
stages.pitfall: 若誤讀徵象：診斷方向錯誤，延誤或過度檢查。
stages.pitfallEn: Misreading the signs sends the work-up in the wrong direction, with delay or over-investigation.

stages.title: 評分
stages.evidence: 住院醫師算出 Alvarado 7 分、AIR 中等風險。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident scores Alvarado 7 and AIR intermediate risk.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 7 分屬高分，免影像直接手術
choices.en: Score 7: operate without imaging

choices.zh: AIR 中等，先出院門診追蹤
choices.en: AIR intermediate: discharge with clinic follow-up

choices.zh: 中高風險，依指引安排影像確認
choices.en: Intermediate-high risk: image as the guideline advises

choices.zh: 改以 CRP 單獨決定是否手術
choices.en: Decide on surgery from CRP alone

stages.reason: 評分用來分層而非單獨診斷；中度風險者以影像降低陰性闌尾切除率。
stages.reasonEn: Scores stratify rather than diagnose alone; imaging in intermediate-risk patients lowers the negative appendicectomy rate.
stages.pitfall: 若憑分數直接開刀：一成以上病人切下正常闌尾。
stages.pitfallEn: Operating on the score alone removes a normal appendix in more than one in ten patients.

stages.title: 檢驗與妊娠試驗
stages.evidence: WBC 14,000、CRP 45；護理師提醒尚未驗尿液 hCG。
stages.evidenceEn: WBC 14,000, CRP 45; the nurse points out that urine hCG has not been sent.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 育齡女性影像手術前必驗 hCG
choices.en: Childbearing age: hCG before imaging or surgery

choices.zh: 發炎指數已高，可省略 hCG
choices.en: Inflammatory markers are high, so skip hCG

choices.zh: hCG 留待術後恢復室再驗即可
choices.en: hCG can wait until recovery after surgery

stages.reason: 妊娠改變鑑別診斷、影像選擇與麻醉；這是一次典型的險些錯失。
stages.reasonEn: Pregnancy changes the differential, imaging choice and anaesthesia; this is a classic near-miss.
stages.pitfall: 若未驗：子宮外孕破裂在手術台上才被發現。
stages.pitfallEn: Unchecked, a ruptured ectopic pregnancy is discovered on the operating table.

stages.title: 影像選擇
stages.evidence: 住院醫師開立腹部 CT；病人 23 歲女性、BMI 21。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident orders an abdominal CT; the patient is a 23-year-old woman with BMI 21.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 直接顯影劑腹部 CT，準確度最高
choices.en: Contrast CT first; it is the most accurate

choices.zh: 先超音波，未確定再 CT/MRI
choices.en: Ultrasound first; CT/MRI if inconclusive

choices.zh: 評分 7 分已足，免影像直接手術
choices.en: A score of 7 is enough: operate without imaging

stages.reason: 分段式影像策略減少輻射；超音波陰性但臨床仍懷疑時再升級。
stages.reasonEn: A staged imaging strategy limits radiation; escalate when ultrasound is negative but suspicion persists.
stages.pitfall: 若一律 CT：年輕族群累積不必要的輻射暴露。
stages.pitfallEn: Routine CT exposes young patients to avoidable radiation.

stages.title: 超音波判讀
stages.evidence: 技術員：不可壓縮的管狀結構，直徑 9 mm，周圍脂肪回音增強。
stages.evidenceEn: Sonographer: non-compressible tubular structure, 9 mm diameter, surrounding fat hyperechoic.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 直徑 9 mm 仍在正常範圍內
choices.en: 9 mm is still within normal limits

choices.zh: 右側輸卵管積水的管狀影像
choices.en: Tubular image of a right hydrosalpinx

choices.zh: 典型急性闌尾炎超音波表現
choices.en: Classic ultrasound signs of acute appendicitis

stages.reason: 直徑大於 6 mm、不可壓縮與周圍脂肪變化是診斷三要素。
stages.reasonEn: Diameter over 6 mm, non-compressibility and periappendiceal fat change are the diagnostic triad.
stages.pitfall: 若未辨識：病人在觀察中進展為穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: Unrecognised, the patient progresses to perforation while under observation.

stages.title: 單純或複雜
stages.evidence: 影像無膿瘍、無糞石、無游離氣體或蜂窩織炎。
stages.evidenceEn: No abscess, appendicolith, free air or phlegmon on imaging.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 單純性：可談抗生素或手術
choices.en: Uncomplicated: discuss antibiotics or surgery

choices.zh: 複雜性闌尾炎，宜先經皮引流
choices.en: Complicated appendicitis: drain percutaneously first

choices.zh: 疑微小穿孔，需緊急開腹探查
choices.en: Likely microperforation: needs urgent laparotomy

stages.reason: 分級決定治療選項；糞石與膿瘍把病人推向手術或引流。
stages.reasonEn: Grading decides the options; an appendicolith or abscess pushes towards surgery or drainage.
stages.pitfall: 若把複雜當單純：抗生素治療失敗、膿瘍擴大。
stages.pitfallEn: Treating complicated disease as uncomplicated fails antibiotics and enlarges the abscess.

stages.title: 抗生素或手術
stages.evidence: 病人問：「可以不開刀嗎？」主治請你說明。
stages.evidenceEn: The patient asks whether she can avoid surgery; the attending asks you to explain.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 抗生素只適用於兒童，成人一律手術
choices.en: Antibiotics only suit children; adults always need surgery

choices.zh: 可談抗生素但復發高，手術為標準
choices.en: Antibiotics an option; high recurrence, surgery standard

choices.zh: 抗生素療效等同手術，復發率低
choices.en: Antibiotics equal surgery with little recurrence

stages.reason: 無糞石的單純性闌尾炎可先抗生素，但一年內約四分之一到三分之一復發，需共同決策。
stages.reasonEn: Uncomplicated appendicitis without an appendicolith may be treated with antibiotics first, but roughly a third recur within a year; it is a shared decision.
stages.pitfall: 若誇大或隱瞞復發率：病人日後對團隊失去信任。
stages.pitfallEn: Overstating or hiding the recurrence rate costs the team the patient's trust later.

stages.title: 知情同意
stages.evidence: 病人選擇腹腔鏡闌尾切除；住院醫師只想請她簽名。
stages.evidenceEn: She chooses laparoscopic appendicectomy; the resident just wants a signature.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 先請她簽名，風險由主刀術前再說
choices.en: Get the signature; the surgeon explains risks later

choices.zh: 只說明腹腔鏡優點，不提轉開腹
choices.en: Stress laparoscopic benefits; skip conversion

choices.zh: 說明轉開腹、感染膿瘍與陰性闌尾
choices.en: Explain conversion, infection, abscess, normal appendix

stages.reason: 有效同意需說明常見與嚴重風險、替代方案與不治療的後果。
stages.reasonEn: Valid consent covers common and serious risks, alternatives and the consequences of no treatment.
stages.pitfall: 若只簽名：併發症發生時變成申訴與法律爭議。
stages.pitfallEn: A bare signature turns a complication into a complaint and a legal dispute.

stages.title: 術前準備與交班
stages.evidence: 夜班交給手術室；禁食時間與抗生素尚未確認。
stages.evidenceEn: Night shift hands over to theatre; fasting time and antibiotics unconfirmed.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 確認禁食與抗生素，SBAR 交班
choices.en: Confirm fasting and antibiotics; hand over with SBAR

choices.zh: 交班即可，抗生素留到劃刀後再給
choices.en: Hand over; give antibiotics after incision

choices.zh: 口頭簡短交班，抗生素由手術室決定
choices.en: Brief verbal handover; theatre decides on antibiotics

stages.reason: 術前抗生素降低手術部位感染；結構化交班避免資訊在夜班遺失。
stages.reasonEn: Preoperative antibiotics reduce surgical-site infection; structured handover stops information being lost overnight.
stages.pitfall: 若交班不完整：抗生素漏給、手術延誤到穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: Incomplete handover misses antibiotics and delays surgery until perforation.

stages.title: 特殊族群：孕婦
stages.evidence: 另一位 20 週孕婦右下腹痛，超音波看不到闌尾。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient, 20 weeks pregnant, right lower quadrant pain; ultrasound cannot see the appendix.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 直接腹部 CT，此週數胎兒劑量可忽略
choices.en: Abdominal CT; fetal dose is negligible at this stage

choices.zh: 無顯影劑 MRI，不行才低劑量 CT
choices.en: Non-contrast MRI; low-dose CT only if unavailable

choices.zh: 產科住院觀察 24 小時，暫不做影像
choices.en: Admit to obstetrics and observe 24 h without imaging

stages.reason: 孕期闌尾炎延誤會增加流產與早產；MRI 無輻射且準確度高。
stages.reasonEn: Delay in pregnancy raises miscarriage and preterm birth; MRI is accurate without radiation.
stages.pitfall: 若拖延：穿孔與胎兒流失風險倍增。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay doubles the risk of perforation and fetal loss.

procedures.title: 腹腔鏡闌尾切除術
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：23 歲女性，超音波證實急性闌尾炎，安排腹腔鏡闌尾切除。主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與你一起完成。本單元教安全檢查、解剖辨識與併發症辨識，不是操作手冊，屬教學情境而非臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 23-year-old woman with ultrasound-confirmed appendicitis scheduled for laparoscopic appendicectomy, with the attending, anaesthetist and scrub nurse. Teaches safety checks, anatomical identification and complication recognition; not an operating manual, an educational scenario rather than a clinical protocol.

stages.title: WHO 核對的發現
stages.titleEn: A finding at the WHO checklist
stages.evidence: 刷手護理師發現同意書寫的是「右側腹股溝疝氣修補」。
stages.evidenceEn: The scrub nurse notices the consent form says right inguinal hernia repair.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 麻醉前請病人口頭確認部位後繼續
choices.en: Ask the patient to confirm the site, then proceed

choices.zh: 暫停，核對身分、術式與同意書
choices.en: Stop; verify identity, procedure and consent

choices.zh: 先依排程開刀，術後再更正同意書
choices.en: Start as scheduled; correct the consent afterwards

stages.reason: 核對表的價值在於有人敢喊停；同意書與手術不符是絕對停止點。
stages.reasonEn: The checklist works only when someone is willing to stop; a consent-procedure mismatch is an absolute stop.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：錯誤手術或無效同意的重大事件。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring it leads to wrong-procedure surgery or invalid consent, a never event.

stages.title: 麻醉與擺位
stages.evidence: 麻醉科請求頭低腳高左傾；病人術前兩小時未排尿。
stages.evidenceEn: Anaesthesia asks for Trendelenburg with left tilt; the patient has not voided for two hours.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 擺位前先排空膀胱並固定雙臂
choices.en: Empty the bladder and secure both arms before tilting

choices.zh: 先擺位，膀胱等術後再處理
choices.en: Position first; deal with the bladder afterwards

choices.zh: 改為右側向下傾斜以暴露闌尾
choices.en: Tilt right-side down to expose the appendix

stages.reason: 脹滿的膀胱在恥骨上入口置放時會被刺穿；左傾讓小腸離開右髂窩。
stages.reasonEn: A full bladder is punctured by a suprapubic port; left tilt moves small bowel out of the right iliac fossa.
stages.pitfall: 若膀胱未排空：套管穿刺膀胱，術後血尿與漏尿。
stages.pitfallEn: An unemptied bladder gets trocar injury with haematuria and urinary leak.

stages.title: 建立氣腹
stages.evidence: 住院醫師用 Veress 針，兩次安全測試都不確定。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident uses a Veress needle; two safety tests are equivocal.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 照常注氣，看初始壓力再判斷
choices.en: Insufflate anyway and judge by opening pressure

choices.zh: 改用開放式 Hasson 法
choices.en: Switch to an open Hasson entry

choices.zh: 調高注氣壓力，看針尖是否在腹腔
choices.en: Raise pressure to check the needle is intraperitoneal

stages.reason: 進入方式沒有絕對安全者，但不確定時改開放式是最低風險的選擇。
stages.reasonEn: No entry technique is risk-free, but switching to open entry when in doubt is the lowest-risk option.
stages.pitfall: 若硬注氣：皮下氣腫、腸或大血管損傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Forcing insufflation causes subcutaneous emphysema or bowel and great-vessel injury.

stages.title: 次要套管置放
stages.evidence: 需要兩個工作套管；助手問要不要直接放。
stages.evidenceEn: Two working ports are needed; the assistant asks whether to just place them.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 依體表標記直接置入，省時間
choices.en: Insert by surface landmarks to save time

choices.zh: 兩個都用 12 mm 以便換鏡
choices.en: Use 12 mm for both to allow scope swaps

choices.zh: 直視下置入，透光避開下腹壁血管
choices.en: Under vision, transilluminate to spare epigastric vessels

stages.reason: 下腹壁血管損傷是常見且可避免的入口併發症。
stages.reasonEn: Inferior epigastric injury is a common and avoidable port complication.
stages.pitfall: 若盲目置入：腹壁血腫或腸穿刺。
stages.pitfallEn: Blind placement causes abdominal wall haematoma or bowel puncture.

stages.title: 探查與辨識
stages.evidence: 闌尾位於盲腸後，尖端被沾黏包住；主治要求先探查。
stages.evidenceEn: The appendix is retrocaecal with its tip wrapped in adhesions; the attending wants a survey first.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 抓住闌尾體部向上牽引，鈍性剝開沾黏
choices.en: Pull up on the appendix body and break adhesions bluntly

choices.zh: 鬆解盲腸外側找尖端，探查迴腸骨盆
choices.en: Mobilise the lateral caecum to find the tip; survey ileum and pelvis

choices.zh: 盲腸後位難以處理，立即轉為開腹
choices.en: Retrocaecal is too hard: convert to open now

stages.reason: 系統性探查排除 Meckel 憩室與婦科病因；拉扯發炎闌尾會使它斷裂。
stages.reasonEn: A systematic survey excludes Meckel's diverticulum and gynaecological causes; pulling on an inflamed appendix tears it.
stages.pitfall: 若拉扯：闌尾斷裂、糞石掉入腹腔形成膿瘍。
stages.pitfallEn: Traction tears the appendix and a dropped appendicolith becomes an abscess.

stages.title: 辨識根部
stages.evidence: 繫膜處理完；住院醫師準備切斷，主治問：「根部在哪？」
stages.evidenceEn: Mesoappendix divided; the resident is ready to cut and the attending asks where the base is.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 沿三條結腸帶匯合處確認根部
choices.en: Follow the taeniae to their confluence to find the base

choices.zh: 在發炎最明顯處切斷，殘端保留較長
choices.en: Divide at the most inflamed point, leaving a longer stump

choices.zh: 以繫膜處理終點直接當作根部
choices.en: Treat the end of the mesentery as the base

stages.reason: 結腸帶匯合處就是闌尾根部；留下殘端過長會造成殘端闌尾炎。
stages.reasonEn: The taeniae converge at the appendiceal base; a long stump causes stump appendicitis.
stages.pitfall: 若殘端過長：數月後「已切除」的病人再度闌尾炎。
stages.pitfallEn: A long stump brings the patient back months later with appendicitis after appendicectomy.

stages.title: 根部壞死
stages.evidence: 根部發黑延伸到盲腸壁；釘合器正要跨過壞死組織。
stages.evidenceEn: The base is black and the necrosis extends onto the caecal wall; the stapler is about to cross it.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 照原位跨根部釘合，再加縫補強
choices.en: Staple at the base and oversew to reinforce

choices.zh: 以荷包縫合將壞死根部內翻包埋
choices.en: Invert the necrotic base with a purse-string

choices.zh: 於健康盲腸壁釘合或部分切盲腸
choices.en: Staple on healthy caecum or do a partial caecectomy

stages.reason: 釘線必須落在有血供的組織；壞死處釘合等於製造漏。
stages.reasonEn: The staple line must sit on vascularised tissue; stapling necrosis guarantees a leak.
stages.pitfall: 若釘在壞死組織：盲腸瘻與糞性腹膜炎。
stages.pitfallEn: A staple line in necrosis becomes a caecal fistula and faecal peritonitis.

stages.title: 標本取出
stages.evidence: 闌尾已切下；助手想直接經套管拉出。
stages.evidenceEn: The appendix is free; the assistant wants to pull it straight through the port.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 裝入取物袋後取出，免傷口汙染
choices.en: Bag it before removal to avoid wound contamination

choices.zh: 經 12 mm 套管直接拉出即可
choices.en: Pull it straight out through the 12 mm port

choices.zh: 擴大臍部傷口，徒手直接取出
choices.en: Widen the umbilical wound and remove it by hand

stages.reason: 取物袋減少入口傷口感染；標本一律送病理。
stages.reasonEn: A retrieval bag lowers port-site infection; every specimen goes to pathology.
stages.pitfall: 若直接拉出：入口傷口感染與罕見的類癌被遺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Direct extraction infects the port site, and an unsent specimen hides a carcinoid.

stages.title: 止血與關閉
stages.evidence: 準備移除套管。
stages.evidenceEn: Preparing to remove the ports.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 維持原氣腹壓查看無出血即拔套管
choices.en: Check for bleeding at full pressure, then remove ports

choices.zh: 所有入口只縫皮膚，筋膜不關
choices.en: Close the skin only at every port

choices.zh: 低壓查止血，縫 10 mm 以上筋膜
choices.en: Check haemostasis at low pressure; close fascia of 10 mm or more

stages.reason: 高壓氣腹會壓住靜脈出血；大的筋膜缺口造成套管疝氣。
stages.reasonEn: High-pressure pneumoperitoneum tamponades venous bleeding; large fascial defects cause port-site hernia.
stages.pitfall: 若未低壓檢查：術後腹腔內出血。
stages.pitfallEn: Without a low-pressure check, the patient bleeds intra-abdominally overnight.

stages.title: 恢復室
stages.evidence: 術後 2 小時：心跳 110、肩痛、腹脹。
stages.evidenceEn: Two hours postoperatively: heart rate 110, shoulder-tip pain, distension.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 殘留氣腹的常見反應，給止痛即可
choices.en: Common after pneumoperitoneum; analgesia is enough

choices.zh: 肩痛常見，心搏過速須排除出血
choices.en: Shoulder pain is common; tachycardia must exclude bleeding

choices.zh: 立即送回手術室再次腹腔鏡探查
choices.en: Return to theatre now for re-laparoscopy

stages.reason: 殘留二氧化碳造成肩痛；但心搏過速是出血最早的徵象。
stages.reasonEn: Residual carbon dioxide causes shoulder pain, but tachycardia is the earliest sign of bleeding.
stages.pitfall: 若歸因於疼痛：血紅素在夜裡悄悄掉到 7。
stages.pitfallEn: Blaming pain lets the haemoglobin drift to 7 overnight.

stages.title: 併發症辨識
stages.evidence: 術後第 5 天：發燒、腹瀉、骨盆壓痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 5: fever, diarrhoea, pelvic tenderness.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 臍部入口傷口感染引起的發燒
choices.en: Fever from an umbilical port-site infection

choices.zh: 病毒性腸胃炎，補液後觀察
choices.en: Viral gastroenteritis: fluids and observe

choices.zh: 骨盆腔膿瘍：影像與引流評估
choices.en: Pelvic abscess: image and assess for drainage

stages.reason: 複雜性闌尾炎後腹內膿瘍約一成；腹瀉來自膿瘍刺激直腸。
stages.reasonEn: Intra-abdominal abscess follows complicated appendicitis in about one in ten; diarrhoea comes from rectal irritation by the collection.
stages.pitfall: 若當腸胃炎：膿瘍破裂成瀰漫性腹膜炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as gastroenteritis, the abscess ruptures into generalised peritonitis.

stages.title: 出院衛教與交班
stages.evidence: 病人準備出院；病房護理師問衛教重點。
stages.evidenceEn: Ready for discharge; the ward nurse asks what to teach.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 教警訊（發燒、劇痛、傷口紅腫）並交班
choices.en: Teach red flags (fever, worsening pain, wound redness) and hand over

choices.zh: 只說明傷口換藥，兩週後門診拆線
choices.en: Explain dressing care; stitches out in two weeks

choices.zh: 囑一個月內臥床休息、避免洗澡
choices.en: Advise bed rest and no showers for a month

stages.reason: 病人是出院後最早的監測者；明確的回診條件讓併發症早一天被發現。
stages.reasonEn: The patient is the first monitor after discharge; clear return criteria catch complications a day earlier.
stages.pitfall: 若衛教缺漏：膿瘍在家惡化到敗血症才回來。
stages.pitfallEn: Without advice, the abscess festers at home until sepsis.

procedures.title: 急性膽囊炎與腹腔鏡膽囊切除：Tokyo 分級、安全關鍵視野與膽管損傷辨識
procedures.titleEn: Acute cholecystitis and laparoscopic cholecystectomy: Tokyo grade, critical view of safety and bile-duct injury recognition
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲女性，右上腹痛兩天、發燒，Murphy 徵象陽性。主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與放射師參與。本單元教分級、時機、安全關鍵視野、脫困策略與膽管損傷辨識；是教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old woman with two days of right upper quadrant pain, fever and a positive Murphy's sign; the attending, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and radiographer take part. Teaches grading, timing, the critical view of safety, bail-out strategies and bile-duct injury recognition; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 臨床懷疑
stages.evidence: 右上腹痛兩天、發燒 38.3°C，吸氣時觸診右上腹病人突然停止呼吸。
stages.evidenceEn: Two days of right upper quadrant pain, 38.3°C, and she catches her breath on inspiratory palpation.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: Murphy 陽性即可診斷，不需影像
choices.en: A positive Murphy's sign is diagnostic; no imaging needed

choices.zh: 疑膽囊炎：抽血並安排超音波
choices.en: Suspected cholecystitis: bloods and ultrasound

choices.zh: 疑膽管結石，直接安排 ERCP
choices.en: Likely duct stone: book ERCP directly

stages.reason: Tokyo 診斷標準結合局部徵象、全身發炎與影像三者。
stages.reasonEn: The Tokyo criteria combine local signs, systemic inflammation and imaging.
stages.pitfall: 若只憑徵象：膽管炎或肝膿瘍被錯當膽囊炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Signs alone mistake cholangitis or a liver abscess for cholecystitis.

stages.title: 超音波判讀
stages.evidence: 膽囊壁 5 mm、周圍積液、多顆結石、總膽管 5 mm、探頭 Murphy 陽性。
stages.evidenceEn: Gallbladder wall 5 mm, pericholecystic fluid, multiple stones, common duct 5 mm, sonographic Murphy's sign positive.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 急性結石性膽囊炎，膽管未擴張
choices.en: Acute calculous cholecystitis, duct not dilated

choices.zh: 急性膽管炎，需緊急膽道引流
choices.en: Acute cholangitis needing urgent biliary drainage

choices.zh: 膽囊壁水腫，多為低白蛋白所致
choices.en: Wall oedema, most likely from hypoalbuminaemia

stages.reason: 壁增厚、積液與探頭 Murphy 是膽囊炎的影像三聯；總膽管正常降低膽管結石機率。
stages.reasonEn: Wall thickening, fluid and sonographic Murphy's sign form the imaging triad; a normal duct lowers the chance of duct stones.
stages.pitfall: 若誤判為膽管炎：病人被送去不必要的 ERCP。
stages.pitfallEn: Mislabelled as cholangitis, she undergoes an unnecessary ERCP.

stages.title: Tokyo 分級
stages.evidence: WBC 19,000、局部腹膜炎、症狀超過 72 小時；血壓與腎功能正常。
stages.evidenceEn: WBC 19,000, local peritonitis, symptoms over 72 hours; blood pressure and renal function normal.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Grade I（輕度）
choices.en: Grade I (mild)

choices.zh: Grade III（重度）
choices.en: Grade III (severe)

choices.zh: Grade II（中度）
choices.en: Grade II (moderate)

stages.reason: Grade II 指明顯局部發炎（WBC >18,000、腫塊、>72 小時、壞疽或膿瘍）；Grade III 需器官功能障礙。
stages.reasonEn: Grade II means marked local inflammation (WBC over 18,000, mass, over 72 hours, gangrene or abscess); grade III requires organ dysfunction.
stages.pitfall: 若分級錯誤：治療強度與手術者資歷配置錯誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Wrong grading mismatches treatment intensity and the seniority of the operator.

stages.title: 手術時機
stages.evidence: 住院醫師建議先抗生素，六週後再排手術。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident suggests antibiotics now and surgery in six weeks.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 抗生素冷卻六週後再擇期手術
choices.en: Antibiotics, then interval surgery at six weeks

choices.zh: 發病一週內早期腹腔鏡切除
choices.en: Early laparoscopic cholecystectomy within a week

choices.zh: 先經皮膽囊引流，再擇期切除
choices.en: Percutaneous drainage, then interval cholecystectomy

stages.reason: 早期手術縮短住院、減少復發；延遲等待反而讓纖維化使解剖更困難。
stages.reasonEn: Early surgery shortens stay and prevents recurrence; waiting lets fibrosis make the anatomy harder.
stages.pitfall: 若延後：等待期間再發作、膽囊壞疽或穿孔。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay brings recurrence, gangrene or perforation while waiting.

stages.title: Grade III 的另一位病人
stages.evidence: 隔壁床 79 歲男性膽囊炎，血壓 85/50、肌酸酐上升、意識改變。
stages.evidenceEn: Next bed: a 79-year-old with cholecystitis, blood pressure 85/50, rising creatinine and altered consciousness.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 復甦、抗生素，考慮膽囊造瘻
choices.en: Resuscitate, antibiotics, consider cholecystostomy

choices.zh: 復甦同時直接送緊急膽囊切除
choices.en: Resuscitate en route to emergency cholecystectomy

choices.zh: 先給抗生素，隔天早上排手術
choices.en: Start antibiotics and list for surgery tomorrow

stages.reason: Grade III 合併器官衰竭者先復甦；高風險者以膽囊造瘻引流，穩定後再評估手術。
stages.reasonEn: Grade III with organ failure needs resuscitation first; high-risk patients are drained by cholecystostomy and reassessed for surgery once stable.
stages.pitfall: 若立即全身麻醉：敗血性休克在誘導時崩潰。
stages.pitfallEn: Immediate general anaesthesia collapses the septic patient at induction.

stages.title: 知情同意
stages.evidence: 主治請你向病人說明手術。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks you to consent the patient.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 強調微創恢復快，罕見風險不需談
choices.en: Stress quick recovery; rare risks need not be discussed

choices.zh: 膽管損傷僅千分之三，可不必告知
choices.en: Bile-duct injury is only 0.3%, so leave it out

choices.zh: 說明轉開腹、膽管損傷、膽漏殘石
choices.en: Explain conversion, duct injury, bile leak, retained stones

stages.reason: 膽管損傷雖少見（約千分之三）但後果重大，屬必須告知的風險。
stages.reasonEn: Bile-duct injury is rare (about 0.3%) but devastating, so it must be disclosed.
stages.pitfall: 若未告知：損傷發生後成為無法辯護的訴訟。
stages.pitfallEn: Undisclosed, an injury becomes an indefensible claim.

stages.title: WHO 核對與設備
stages.evidence: 刷手護理師核對；主治問膽道攝影設備是否備妥。
stages.evidenceEn: The scrub nurse runs the checklist; the attending asks whether cholangiography is set up.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 確認身分與手術部位後就開始劃刀
choices.en: Confirm identity and site, then start

choices.zh: 膽道攝影設備等術中需要再臨時借
choices.en: Borrow cholangiography kit if it becomes needed

choices.zh: 確認身分、抗生素與膽道攝影待命
choices.en: Confirm identity, antibiotics and cholangiography on standby

stages.reason: 困難膽囊可能需要術中膽道攝影；事前備妥才不會在關鍵時刻放棄。
stages.reasonEn: A difficult gallbladder may need intraoperative cholangiography; having it ready stops the team abandoning it at the critical moment.
stages.pitfall: 若未備妥：解剖不清時只能猜。
stages.pitfallEn: Without it, unclear anatomy is guessed at.

stages.title: 暴露
stages.evidence: 膽囊張力大、水腫，抓鉗抓不住。
stages.evidenceEn: The gallbladder is tense and oedematous; the grasper cannot hold it.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 換大齒抓鉗，加大力道夾住膽囊底
choices.en: Use a toothed grasper and grip the fundus harder

choices.zh: 先抽吸減壓，再夾底部向頭側拉
choices.en: Aspirate to decompress, then retract the fundus cephalad

choices.zh: 張力大無法牽引，立即轉開腹
choices.en: Too tense to retract: convert to open now

stages.reason: 減壓讓牽引有效；底部向頭側、漏斗部向外側牽引才能展開肝膽三角。
stages.reasonEn: Decompression makes retraction effective; fundus cephalad and infundibulum lateral opens the hepatocystic triangle.
stages.pitfall: 若硬抓：膽囊破裂、結石散落腹腔。
stages.pitfallEn: Forcing it ruptures the gallbladder and scatters stones.

stages.title: 安全關鍵視野
stages.evidence: 肝膽三角已清出，只見兩個結構進入膽囊，膽囊下三分之一已離開肝床。
stages.evidenceEn: The triangle is cleared of fat, only two structures enter the gallbladder and the lower third is off the liver bed.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 三要件皆達成，可以夾閉
choices.en: All three criteria met; safe to clip

choices.zh: 仍需完整顯露總膽管才可夾閉
choices.en: The common bile duct must be exposed first

choices.zh: 需再做膽道攝影才算安全視野
choices.en: Cholangiography is still needed to confirm CVS

stages.reason: CVS 三要件：清除脂肪與纖維組織、僅兩結構進入膽囊、膽囊板下部與肝床分離；不要求顯露總膽管。
stages.reasonEn: The three CVS criteria: triangle cleared, exactly two structures entering the gallbladder, lower gallbladder separated from the liver bed; exposing the common duct is not required.
stages.pitfall: 若未達 CVS 就夾：把總膽管誤認為膽囊管。
stages.pitfallEn: Clipping before CVS mistakes the common duct for the cystic duct.

stages.title: 險些錯失
stages.evidence: 住院醫師說這是膽囊管，但它粗大且往肝門方向走。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident calls it the cystic duct, but it is wide and heads towards the hilum.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 依住院醫師判斷，雙夾後切斷
choices.en: Trust the resident: double-clip and divide

choices.zh: 剪一小口，看是否有膽汁流出
choices.en: Nick it and see whether bile comes out

choices.zh: 暫停，膽道攝影或請資深醫師
choices.en: Pause: cholangiogram or call a senior

stages.reason: 錯覺性感知是膽管損傷的主因；懷疑時「暫停」是最便宜的保險。
stages.reasonEn: Misperception is the main cause of duct injury; a pause when in doubt is the cheapest insurance.
stages.pitfall: 若夾閉：總膽管橫斷，病人需肝管空腸吻合。
stages.pitfallEn: Clipping transects the common duct and the patient needs a hepaticojejunostomy.

stages.title: 脫困策略
stages.evidence: 嚴重纖維化，無法達到安全關鍵視野。
stages.evidenceEn: Dense fibrosis; the critical view cannot be achieved.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 往肝門深處繼續解剖找膽囊管
choices.en: Dissect deeper towards the hilum to find the duct

choices.zh: 直接關閉，改長期抗生素治療
choices.en: Close and switch to long-term antibiotics

choices.zh: 次全膽囊切除或轉開腹
choices.en: Subtotal cholecystectomy or convert to open

stages.reason: 次全切除（開窗或重建型）避開危險區；轉開腹不是失敗而是判斷。
stages.reasonEn: Subtotal cholecystectomy (fenestrating or reconstituting) avoids the danger zone; conversion is judgement, not failure.
stages.pitfall: 若硬解剖：血管膽管合併損傷。
stages.pitfallEn: Forcing the dissection causes combined vasculobiliary injury.

stages.title: 止血與關閉
stages.evidence: 肝床持續滲血；助手想直接關閉。
stages.evidenceEn: The liver bed keeps oozing; the assistant wants to close.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 壓迫止血、確認夾子，考慮放引流
choices.en: Compress, use haemostats, check clips, consider a drain

choices.zh: 肝床滲血多半會自止，可直接關閉
choices.en: Liver-bed ooze stops by itself; close now

choices.zh: 高氣腹壓下確認無出血即關閉
choices.en: Close once dry at full insufflation pressure

stages.reason: 低壓檢查肝床與夾子；困難病例引流可早期偵測膽漏。
stages.reasonEn: Check the bed and clips at low pressure; a drain in difficult cases detects bile leak early.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：術後血腫與肝下膿瘍。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored oozing becomes a haematoma and subhepatic abscess.

stages.title: 膽管損傷辨識
stages.evidence: 術後第 2 天黃疸、引流膽汁；MRCP 顯示總肝管中斷。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 2: jaundice, bile in the drain; MRCP shows an interrupted common hepatic duct.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: Strasberg A，ERCP 放支架即可
choices.en: Strasberg A: an ERCP stent will do

choices.zh: Strasberg E 損傷，轉肝膽專科
choices.en: Strasberg E: refer to a hepatobiliary centre

choices.zh: 由原團隊立即開腹做膽管端端吻合
choices.en: Original team re-operates with end-to-end repair

stages.reason: Strasberg A 是膽囊管殘端或 Luschka 管滲漏；E 型是主要膽管橫斷，由專科修補成功率最高。
stages.reasonEn: Strasberg A is a cystic stump or Luschka duct leak; type E is major duct transection, best repaired at a specialist centre.
stages.pitfall: 若由原團隊貿然修補：狹窄與反覆膽管炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Repair by the original team leads to stricture and recurrent cholangitis.

stages.title: 出院與交班
stages.evidence: 另一位順利的病人準備出院；護理師問回診條件。
stages.evidenceEn: An uncomplicated patient is going home; the nurse asks about return criteria.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 黃疸、發燒或腹痛加劇須立即回診
choices.en: Jaundice, fever or worsening pain: return at once

choices.zh: 傷口照護即可，兩週後門診追蹤
choices.en: Wound care only; clinic review in two weeks

choices.zh: 只需避免油膩，無須特別回診條件
choices.en: Avoid fatty food; no special return criteria

stages.reason: 膽漏常在出院後才表現；病人需要知道黃疸與發燒是回診訊號。
stages.reasonEn: Bile leaks often declare after discharge; the patient must know that jaundice and fever are return signals.
stages.pitfall: 若無衛教：膽汁性腹膜炎在家發展數天。
stages.pitfallEn: Without advice, biliary peritonitis develops at home for days.

procedures.title: 總膽管結石路徑：風險分層、ERCP 或膽管探查
procedures.titleEn: Choledocholithiasis pathway: risk stratification, ERCP or duct exploration
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲男性，黃疸合併膽絞痛，無發燒。消化科內視鏡醫師、肝膽外科主治與放射師共同決策。本單元教風險分層與路徑選擇，不含內視鏡操作參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old man with jaundice and biliary colic, no fever. The endoscopist, hepatobiliary attending and radiographer decide together. Teaches risk stratification and pathway choice, without endoscopic settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 術中膽道攝影與膽管探查

stages.title: 病史
stages.evidence: 黃疸、茶色尿、間歇右上腹絞痛；無發燒、無體重減輕。
stages.evidenceEn: Jaundice, dark urine, intermittent right upper quadrant colic; no fever, no weight loss.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 病毒性肝炎可能大，先驗肝炎標記
choices.en: Likely viral hepatitis: send hepatitis serology

choices.zh: 胰頭癌可能大，先排胰臟 CT
choices.en: Likely pancreatic head cancer: pancreatic CT

choices.zh: 疑膽管結石：驗肝功能、做超音波
choices.en: Suspected duct stone: liver tests and ultrasound

stages.reason: 疼痛性黃疸指向結石；無痛性黃疸加體重減輕才指向惡性。
stages.reasonEn: Painful jaundice points to stones; painless jaundice with weight loss points to malignancy.
stages.pitfall: 若未分辨：惡性阻塞被當結石追蹤數月。
stages.pitfallEn: Undifferentiated, a malignant obstruction is followed as a stone for months.

stages.title: 肝功能判讀
stages.evidence: 膽紅素 4.2 mg/dL、ALP 420、ALT 150、GGT 高。
stages.evidenceEn: Bilirubin 4.2 mg/dL, ALP 420, ALT 150, raised GGT.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 膽汁滯留型，支持膽管阻塞
choices.en: Cholestatic pattern: duct obstruction

choices.zh: 肝細胞損傷型，偏向急性肝炎
choices.en: Hepatocellular pattern pointing to hepatitis

choices.zh: 溶血型黃疸，需驗網狀紅血球
choices.en: Haemolytic jaundice: check reticulocytes

stages.reason: ALP 與 GGT 不成比例上升代表膽汁滯留；早期阻塞 ALT 也可能先升。
stages.reasonEn: Disproportionate ALP and GGT indicate cholestasis; ALT may rise first in early obstruction.
stages.pitfall: 若判讀錯誤：病人被送去肝炎門診而非膽道處理。
stages.pitfallEn: Misread, he is referred to a hepatitis clinic instead of biliary treatment.

stages.title: 超音波
stages.evidence: 總膽管 10 mm、膽囊多顆結石，但未見膽管內結石。
stages.evidenceEn: Common duct 10 mm, multiple gallbladder stones, no duct stone seen.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 超音波未見膽管結石，已可排除
choices.en: No stone seen on ultrasound, so excluded

choices.zh: 膽管擴張強提示結石，超音波易漏
choices.en: Dilatation strongly predicts stones; ultrasound often misses them

choices.zh: 10 mm 屬正常老化，直接切膽囊
choices.en: 10 mm is normal ageing; proceed to cholecystectomy

stages.reason: 超音波看膽管遠端常被腸氣遮蔽，敏感度僅約五成。
stages.reasonEn: The distal duct is often hidden by bowel gas; ultrasound sensitivity is only about 50%.
stages.pitfall: 若因此排除：結石留在膽管，術後膽管炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Excluding stones on this basis leaves them in the duct and causes postoperative cholangitis.

stages.title: 風險分層
stages.evidence: 膽紅素 >4 mg/dL 加膽管擴張；無膽管炎。
stages.evidenceEn: Bilirubin over 4 mg/dL with a dilated duct; no cholangitis.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 低風險，先做膽囊切除術
choices.en: Low risk: cholecystectomy first

choices.zh: 中風險，先安排 MRCP
choices.en: Intermediate risk: arrange MRCP first

choices.zh: 高風險，直接 ERCP
choices.en: High risk: proceed to ERCP

stages.reason: 影像見結石、膽管炎，或膽紅素 >4 合併擴張膽管屬高風險，直接治療性 ERCP。
stages.reasonEn: A stone on imaging, cholangitis, or bilirubin over 4 with a dilated duct is high risk and goes straight to therapeutic ERCP.
stages.pitfall: 若高風險者先做 MRCP：延誤且重複檢查。
stages.pitfallEn: MRCP in a high-risk patient only delays and duplicates.

stages.title: 中風險的另一位病人
stages.evidence: 另一位病人膽紅素 1.8、總膽管 7 mm、無結石影像。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient: bilirubin 1.8, duct 7 mm, no stone seen.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 直接安排 ERCP 取石，一次解決
choices.en: Book ERCP and clear the duct in one go

choices.zh: MRCP 或 EUS 確認後再決定
choices.en: Confirm with MRCP or EUS first

choices.zh: 膽紅素僅輕微上升，門診追蹤
choices.en: Mild bilirubin rise: clinic follow-up

stages.reason: 中風險者以非侵入性影像避免約四成不必要的 ERCP。
stages.reasonEn: Non-invasive imaging in intermediate risk avoids an unnecessary ERCP in around 40%.
stages.pitfall: 若直接 ERCP：承受胰臟炎風險卻找不到結石。
stages.pitfallEn: A direct ERCP risks pancreatitis and finds no stone.

stages.title: ERCP 的同意
stages.evidence: 內視鏡醫師請你協助說明。
stages.evidenceEn: The endoscopist asks you to help explain.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 說明術後胰臟炎、出血與穿孔
choices.en: Explain post-ERCP pancreatitis, bleeding and perforation

choices.zh: 內視鏡無傷口，風險可忽略
choices.en: No incision, so the risks are negligible

choices.zh: 同意由內視鏡室當天自行處理
choices.en: Leave consent to the endoscopy unit on the day

stages.reason: ERCP 後胰臟炎約 3–5%，是最常見且需告知的併發症。
stages.reasonEn: Post-ERCP pancreatitis occurs in roughly 3-5% and is the commonest complication to disclose.
stages.pitfall: 若未告知：併發症被病人視為錯誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Undisclosed, the complication is perceived as an error.

stages.title: ERCP 後第二天
stages.evidence: 上腹痛放射到背、脂肪酶高出三倍以上。
stages.evidenceEn: Epigastric pain radiating to the back, lipase more than three times normal.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 術後常見的高澱粉酶血症，不需處理
choices.en: Common post-procedure hyperamylasaemia; no action

choices.zh: 十二指腸後壁穿孔，需緊急手術
choices.en: Retroduodenal perforation needing urgent surgery

choices.zh: ERCP 後胰臟炎，照胰臟炎處理
choices.en: Post-ERCP pancreatitis: manage as pancreatitis

stages.reason: ERCP 後高澱粉酶常見，但疼痛加脂肪酶三倍才是胰臟炎。
stages.reasonEn: Hyperamylasaemia after ERCP is common; pain with lipase over three times normal defines pancreatitis.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：重度胰臟炎延誤輸液。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, severe pancreatitis goes under-resuscitated.

stages.title: 單階段策略
stages.evidence: 另一病人術中膽道攝影發現 6 mm 膽管結石。
stages.evidenceEn: In another patient, intraoperative cholangiography shows a 6 mm duct stone.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 腹腔鏡探查或術後 ERCP，依團隊而定
choices.en: Laparoscopic exploration or postoperative ERCP, per team expertise

choices.zh: 6 mm 結石多會自行排出，不處理
choices.en: A 6 mm stone will pass; leave it

choices.zh: 立即轉開腹，切開總膽管取石放 T 管
choices.en: Convert, open the duct and leave a T-tube

stages.reason: 單階段腹腔鏡探查與兩階段 ERCP 結果相當；選擇取決於團隊能力。
stages.reasonEn: Single-stage laparoscopic exploration and two-stage ERCP have equivalent outcomes; the choice depends on team capability.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：術後黃疸與膽漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, the stone causes postoperative jaundice and leak.

stages.title: 膽管炎辨識
stages.evidence: 急診另一病人：發燒 39°C、黃疸、意識混亂、血壓 88/50。
stages.evidenceEn: Another ED patient: 39°C, jaundice, confusion, blood pressure 88/50.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 先抗生素 48 小時，無效再引流
choices.en: Antibiotics for 48 h; drain only if no response

choices.zh: 重度膽管炎：復甦並緊急膽道減壓
choices.en: Severe cholangitis: resuscitate and urgently decompress

choices.zh: 先等 MRCP 確認結石再處理
choices.en: Await MRCP to confirm the stone first

stages.reason: Reynolds 五聯徵代表 Tokyo Grade III 膽管炎；減壓是治療核心，不是抗生素。
stages.reasonEn: Reynolds' pentad means Tokyo grade III cholangitis; decompression, not antibiotics, is the definitive treatment.
stages.pitfall: 若延誤減壓：多重器官衰竭。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed decompression ends in multi-organ failure.

stages.title: 膽囊切除時機
stages.evidence: ERCP 已清除結石；病人問何時切膽囊。
stages.evidenceEn: The duct is cleared; he asks when the gallbladder comes out.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: ERCP 已取石，膽囊可保留
choices.en: Stones cleared by ERCP, so keep the gallbladder

choices.zh: 同次住院內腹腔鏡膽囊切除
choices.en: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy in the same admission

choices.zh: 等發炎完全消退，三個月後再切
choices.en: Wait three months for inflammation to settle

stages.reason: ERCP 後兩週內切除比延遲減少再發膽道事件。
stages.reasonEn: Cholecystectomy within two weeks of ERCP lowers recurrent biliary events compared with delay.
stages.pitfall: 若延遲：等待期間再發膽管炎或胰臟炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Delay brings recurrent cholangitis or pancreatitis while waiting.

stages.title: 出院與追蹤
stages.evidence: 病人完成兩階段治療準備出院。
stages.evidenceEn: He has completed two-stage treatment and is going home.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 結石已清除，門診結案即可
choices.en: Stones cleared: discharge from clinic

choices.zh: 每年常規 ERCP 監測再發結石
choices.en: Yearly routine ERCP to watch for new stones

choices.zh: 追蹤肝功能並衛教膽管炎症狀
choices.en: Check liver tests; teach cholangitis symptoms

stages.reason: 殘留或再生結石可能在數月後出現；病人需知道黃疸與發燒要回診。
stages.reasonEn: Residual or recurrent stones can appear months later; the patient must know that jaundice and fever mean return.
stages.pitfall: 若無衛教：再發膽管炎在家惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: Without advice, recurrent cholangitis worsens at home.

procedures.title: 小腸阻塞：沾黏或疝氣、缺血警訊與手術時機
procedures.titleEn: Small bowel obstruction: adhesions or hernia, ischaemia warning signs and timing of surgery
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：70 歲女性，子宮切除病史，嘔吐兩天、腹脹、無排氣。急診主治、外科住院醫師與放射師共同處理。本單元教鑑別、缺血警訊與保守／手術決策；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 70-year-old woman with a previous hysterectomy, two days of vomiting, distension and no flatus. The ED attending, surgical resident and radiographer manage her. Teaches differentiation, ischaemia warning signs and the conservative-versus-surgery decision; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 消化性潰瘍穿孔：敗血症復甦與修補
procedures.titleEn: Perforated peptic ulcer: sepsis resuscitation and repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：45 歲男性，長期服用 NSAID，突發上腹劇痛、板狀腹。急診主治、麻醉科醫師與外科團隊共同處理。本單元教辨識、復甦與修補原則，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 45-year-old man on long-term NSAIDs with sudden severe epigastric pain and a rigid abdomen, managed by the ED attending, anaesthetist and surgical team. Teaches recognition, resuscitation and repair principles without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 急性胰臟炎：嚴重度、壞死與分階段介入
procedures.titleEn: Acute pancreatitis: severity, necrosis and step-up intervention
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲女性，上腹痛放射到背、嘔吐，脂肪酶高於正常三倍以上。病房主治、營養師、放射師與加護團隊參與。本單元教診斷、嚴重度分級與介入時機，不含輸液或藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 52-year-old woman with epigastric pain radiating to the back, vomiting and lipase more than three times normal. The ward attending, dietitian, radiographer and ICU team take part. Teaches diagnosis, severity grading and timing of intervention without fluid or drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 上消化道內視鏡基礎與異物處理
procedures.titleEn: Upper GI endoscopy basics and foreign body management
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲男性，吞嚥困難三個月、體重減輕 5 公斤，安排上消化道內視鏡；同日另一位兒童吞下鈕扣電池。內視鏡醫師、麻醉護理師與你一起工作。本單元教適應症、安全與分流，不含設備設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 55-year-old man with three months of dysphagia and 5 kg weight loss booked for upper endoscopy; the same day a child swallows a button battery. The endoscopist, sedation nurse and you work together. Teaches indications, safety and triage without device settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 肝臟病灶的評估：影像特徵、切片角色與治療分期
procedures.titleEn: Hepatic lesion work-up: imaging features, role of biopsy and treatment staging
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲男性 B 型肝炎帶原，超音波篩檢發現 3 公分肝病灶。肝膽外科主治、放射科醫師與腫瘤科在多專科會議討論。本單元教影像判讀與分期決策；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 52-year-old man with chronic hepatitis B and a 3 cm liver lesion on surveillance ultrasound, discussed by the hepatobiliary attending, radiologist and oncologist at the MDT. Teaches imaging interpretation and staging decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腹腔高壓與腹腔隔室症候群
procedures.titleEn: Intra-abdominal hypertension and abdominal compartment syndrome
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：38 歲男性重度胰臟炎，大量輸液後腹脹、尿量下降、呼吸器氣道壓上升。加護主治、外科主治、呼吸治療師與護理師共同處理。本單元教測量、分級與減壓決策，不含設備設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old man with severe pancreatitis who, after large-volume resuscitation, develops distension, falling urine output and rising airway pressures on the ventilator. The intensivist, surgeon, respiratory therapist and nurse manage him together. Teaches measurement, grading and decompression decisions without device settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腹股溝疝氣修補：開放或腹腔鏡、神經保護與慢性疼痛
procedures.titleEn: Inguinal hernia repair: open or laparoscopic, nerve protection and chronic pain
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：45 歲男性倉儲工人，右鼠蹊可復位腫塊半年，站立與搬重時明顯。門診主治、麻醉科醫師與刷手護理師參與。本單元教診斷、術式選擇、解剖安全與併發症辨識，不含網片規格或固定器材設定；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 45-year-old warehouse worker with a reducible right groin lump for six months, worse on standing and lifting; the clinic attending, anaesthetist and scrub nurse take part. Teaches diagnosis, choice of repair, anatomical safety and complication recognition without mesh specifications or fixation settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 嵌頓與絞窄性疝氣急症
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：78 歲女性，右鼠蹊疼痛腫塊 10 小時、嘔吐，腫塊發紅、無法推回。急診主治、麻醉科醫師與值班外科團隊處理。本單元教辨識、復位禁忌、腸活性判斷與修補原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 78-year-old woman with a painful right groin lump for 10 hours, vomiting, the lump red and irreducible; managed by the ED attending, anaesthetist and on-call surgical team. Teaches recognition, when not to reduce, bowel viability and repair principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 切口疝與腹壁疝修補：術前最佳化與網片位置
procedures.titleEn: Incisional and ventral hernia repair: optimisation and mesh position
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：62 歲女性，BMI 36、吸菸、第二型糖尿病，正中切口疝氣 8 公分寬。腹壁重建主治、麻醉科醫師與造口／傷口護理師共同規劃。本單元教預康復、網片位置與併發症辨識；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 62-year-old woman, BMI 36, smoker, type 2 diabetes, with an 8 cm wide midline incisional hernia; planned by the abdominal wall attending, anaesthetist and wound nurse. Teaches prehabilitation, mesh position and complication recognition; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 筋膜關閉與肌筋膜分離

procedures.title: 大腸直腸癌：轉診、分期與多專科決策
procedures.titleEn: Colorectal cancer: referral, staging and multidisciplinary decisions
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲男性，排便習慣改變三個月、缺鐵性貧血。家醫、內視鏡醫師、放射科醫師與大腸直腸外科主治在多專科會議上討論。本單元教警訊、分期與治療順序決策；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man with three months of altered bowel habit and iron-deficiency anaemia; the GP, endoscopist, radiologist and colorectal attending discuss him at the MDT. Teaches alarm features, staging and sequencing decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腹腔鏡大腸切除與吻合：ERAS、輸尿管安全與吻合檢查
procedures.titleEn: Laparoscopic colectomy and anastomosis: ERAS, ureteric safety and anastomotic checks
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲男性乙狀結腸癌，安排腹腔鏡前切除。主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與 ERAS 護理師參與。本單元教準備、解剖安全與吻合品質檢查，不含器械設定或步驟手冊；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man with sigmoid cancer scheduled for laparoscopic anterior resection, with the attending, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and ERAS nurse. Teaches preparation, anatomical safety and anastomotic quality checks without instrument settings or a step manual; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 吻合口滲漏的早期辨識與處理
procedures.titleEn: Early recognition and management of anastomotic leak
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：前切除術後第 3 天的 58 歲男性，心跳 105、呼吸 22，護理師說「看起來還好」。病房主治、放射科醫師與加護團隊參與。本單元教警訊、CRP 趨勢、分級與介入選擇；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man on day 3 after anterior resection, heart rate 105, respiratory rate 22; the nurse says he looks fine. The ward attending, radiologist and ICU team take part. Teaches warning signs, CRP trends, grading and choice of intervention; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 造口成形與造口照護
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：64 歲女性，急診 Hartmann 手術需末端結腸造口；另一位病人需暫時性迴腸造口。造口師、主治與病房護理師參與。本單元教標記、成形原則、袋具與併發症辨識；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 64-year-old woman needing an end colostomy at emergency Hartmann's procedure, and another patient needing a temporary ileostomy; the stoma nurse, attending and ward nurse take part. Teaches siting, formation principles, appliances and complication recognition; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 下消化道出血：復甦、定位與介入階梯
procedures.titleEn: Lower GI bleeding: resuscitation, localisation and the intervention ladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：72 歲男性服用 apixaban，大量鮮血便，心跳 112、血壓 95/60。急診主治、內視鏡醫師、介入放射科醫師與血液科參與。本單元教分流、抗凝處理與介入順序，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 72-year-old man on apixaban with brisk haematochezia, heart rate 112, blood pressure 95/60; the ED attending, endoscopist, interventional radiologist and haematologist take part. Teaches triage, anticoagulant handling and intervention sequence without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 急性憩室炎：Hinchey 分級與處置階梯
procedures.titleEn: Acute diverticulitis: Hinchey grading and the management ladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲男性，左下腹痛三天、發燒。急診主治、放射科醫師與大腸直腸外科共同處理；同時段另有兩位不同嚴重度的病人。本單元教分級、抗生素選擇性使用與手術決策；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 55-year-old man with three days of left lower quadrant pain and fever, managed by the ED attending, radiologist and colorectal surgeons, alongside two other patients of differing severity. Teaches grading, selective antibiotic use and surgical decisions; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 肛門直腸疾病：膿瘍、瘻管與痔瘡
procedures.titleEn: Anorectal disease: abscess, fistula and haemorrhoids
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：35 歲男性肛門疼痛腫脹三天、發燒；門診同時有瘻管與痔瘡病人。大腸直腸外科主治、麻醉科醫師與門診護理師參與。本單元教分類、術式選擇與括約肌安全；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 35-year-old man with three days of painful anal swelling and fever, alongside fistula and haemorrhoid patients in the same clinic; the colorectal attending, anaesthetist and clinic nurse take part. Teaches classification, choice of procedure and sphincter safety; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 乳房腫塊三合一評估
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲女性自摸到左乳外上象限硬塊三週，無家族史。乳房外科主治、放射科醫師與病理科在同日門診完成評估。本單元教三合一評估邏輯與結果整合；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 42-year-old woman who found a firm lump in the upper outer left breast three weeks ago, no family history; the breast surgeon, radiologist and pathologist complete a one-stop assessment. Teaches the logic of triple assessment and integrating results; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 乳房保留手術與前哨淋巴結切片
procedures.titleEn: Wide local excision and sentinel lymph node biopsy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲女性，2 cm 侵襲性乳管癌、臨床腋下陰性，安排乳房保留手術與前哨淋巴結切片。主治、麻醉科醫師、核醫技師與病理科參與。本單元教定位、切緣、前哨淋巴結原則與併發症；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 42-year-old woman with a 2 cm invasive ductal carcinoma and clinically negative axilla, scheduled for wide local excision and sentinel node biopsy; the attending, anaesthetist, nuclear medicine technologist and pathologist take part. Teaches localisation, margins, sentinel node principles and complications; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 甲狀腺切除：喉返神經與副甲狀腺保護、術後血腫與低血鈣
procedures.titleEn: Thyroidectomy: recurrent laryngeal nerve and parathyroid protection, haematoma and hypocalcaemia
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：48 歲女性，3 cm 甲狀腺結節，細針抽吸 Bethesda V，安排甲狀腺全切除。內分泌外科主治、麻醉科醫師、刷手護理師與病房護理師參與。本單元教術前評估、神經與副甲狀腺保護、氣道急症辨識；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 48-year-old woman with a 3 cm thyroid nodule, FNA Bethesda V, scheduled for total thyroidectomy; the endocrine surgeon, anaesthetist, scrub nurse and ward nurse take part. Teaches preoperative assessment, nerve and parathyroid protection and airway emergency recognition; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 創傷剖腹與損傷控制手術
procedures.titleEn: Trauma laparotomy and damage control surgery
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲男性高速車禍，血壓 80/50、心跳 130，FAST 陽性。創傷隊長、麻醉科醫師、血庫、刷手護理師與加護團隊啟動大量輸血。本單元教決策順序、損傷控制哲學與致命三角辨識，不含手術步驟細節；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old man after a high-speed crash, blood pressure 80/50, heart rate 130, FAST positive; the trauma team leader, anaesthetist, blood bank, scrub nurse and ICU team activate massive transfusion. Teaches decision sequence, damage control philosophy and the lethal triad without operative detail; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 脾臟損傷：AAST 分級與非手術治療
procedures.titleEn: Splenic injury: AAST grading and non-operative management
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：19 歲男性騎單車撞上車門，左上腹痛與左肩痛，血壓 118/70、心跳 98。創傷主治、放射科醫師與介入放射科共同決策。本單元教分級、非手術治療條件與失敗辨識；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 19-year-old cyclist hit by a car door, left upper quadrant and left shoulder pain, blood pressure 118/70, heart rate 98; the trauma attending, radiologist and interventional radiologist decide together. Teaches grading, non-operative criteria and recognising failure; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 壞死性軟組織感染的辨識與清創
procedures.titleEn: Necrotising soft-tissue infection: recognition and debridement
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲糖尿病男性，小腿「蜂窩織炎」兩天，疼痛與外觀不成比例、心跳 125、意識混亂。急診主治、外科主治、麻醉科醫師與加護團隊參與。本單元教辨識、不延誤的手術時機與再探查原則，不含抗生素劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old diabetic man with two days of "cellulitis" of the calf, pain out of proportion, heart rate 125 and confusion; the ED attending, surgeon, anaesthetist and ICU team take part. Teaches recognition, surgery without delay and second-look principles without antibiotic doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 減重手術路徑與滲漏辨識

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old woman, BMI 44, type 2 diabetes and sleep apnoea, scheduled for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy after multidisciplinary assessment; the bariatric surgeon, anaesthetist, dietitian and psychologist take part. procedures.title: 手術部位感染與傷口裂開
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲男性，開腹大腸切除術後第 5 天，傷口紅腫滲液、發燒。病房主治、傷口護理師與住院醫師共同處理；第 8 天出現新的警訊。本單元教分類、預防組套、辨識與處理原則；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。

Teaches classification, prevention bundle, recognition and management principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: ERAS 路徑與術後腸麻痺

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old woman after laparoscopic right hemicolectomy on an ERAS pathway who develops distension and vomiting on day 3; the ERAS nurse, ward attending, physiotherapist and pharmacist take part. Teaches pathway elements and distinguishing and managing ileus versus obstruction; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 軟組織腫塊與藏毛竇門診：脂肪瘤、皮脂腺囊腫與肉瘤警訊

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a clinic morning with three patients: a soft back lump, an inflamed scalp cyst and a 22-year-old man with a painful swelling over the coccyx, seen by the general surgeon and clinic nurse. Teaches benign lumps versus sarcoma red flags, pilonidal management and excision principles; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.
